summary.text: Glen Womack is a Republican member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 32, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Avoyelles, Caldwell, Catahoula, Concordia, Franklin, LaSalle, Ouachita, Rapides, Richland, and West Feliciana parishes. First elected in 2019, Glen Womack chairs the Finance Committee and serves as vice chair of the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget.

paragraphs.text: The Senate page lists Glen Womack's committee assignments as Finance (chair), Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Senate and Governmental Affairs, Revenue and Fiscal Affairs (ex officio), Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget (vice chair), Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee, Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, Legislative Budgetary Control Council, State Bond Commission, and Senate Executive Committee, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
